verdict.rationale: Orb documents several configurable billing processes that run in the background without manual steps: automatic invoice issuance after grace periods, automatic dunning retries on a 1/4/9-day schedule, managed daily data exports, usage-threshold and credit-balance alerts, and automatic token top-ups. These are fixed, predefined billing behaviors with on/off settings, not a general facility for users to define their own autonomous automations. missing for 10: a user-defined automation or workflow builder, arbitrary triggers and actions beyond built-in billing flows, agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Invoices auto-issue after grace periods and buffers
Orb will automatically retry the charge after 1, 4, and 9 days from the initial payment attempt.
